name: Hotel Raghu
area: Near Gomateshwara statue entry gate, Shravanabelagola
why_it_matters: A pure-veg restaurant just 50 metres outside the entry gate of the Gomateshwara (Bahubali) statue — the most convenient sit-down meal in Shravanabelagola, a small Jain pilgrimage town. The unlimited South Indian thali with brinjal curry, lemon rasam, dantina sambar, shavige payasam, chapati, curd and rice is the order.
insider_tip: The closest proper restaurant to the Gomateshwara climb — handy before or after the 600-plus-step ascent of Vindhyagiri. The unlimited thali is excellent value; breakfast runs dosa, idli, vada and ghee roast. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Hotel Raghu, near Gomateshwara statue entry gate, Shravanabelagola, Hassan District, Karnataka 573135

name: Suranga Jain Marwadi Bhojanalya
area: Jain Mutt Road, near temple entrance, Shravanabelagola
why_it_matters: A Marwadi Jain bhojanalaya on Jain Mutt Road, five or six shops to the left of the temple main entrance — one of the few dedicated places to eat proper Jain food in Shravanabelagola, serving a traditional Marwadi thali of phulka, subzi, kadhi, dal, rice, papad and pickle. Some reviewers call it the best place to eat in town.
insider_tip: A genuine Marwadi Jain kitchen — handy for pilgrims wanting strict Jain food rather than generic South Indian. Aloo paratha at breakfast, kadhi-and-aloo thali for lunch and dinner. Reviews on price are mixed; confirm what the thali includes. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Suranga Jain Marwadi Bhojanalya, Jain Mutt Road, near temple entrance, Shravanabelagola, Hassan District, Karnataka 573135

name: Shri Digambar Jain Math Bhojanalaya
area: Shri Digambar Jain Mahasamsthan Math, Shravanabelagola
signature_dish: Free pilgrim meal at the Jain Math
why_it_matters: The bhojanalaya of the Shri Digambar Jain Mahasamsthan Math — the centuries-old monastery at Shravanabelagola, about 400 metres from the bus stand near Vindhyagiri Hill. The Math runs annadana / sathkara bhojanalaya programmes providing simple pure-veg meals to pilgrims, funded by devotee seva donations.
insider_tip: A pilgrim-meal service run by the Jain Math, not a restaurant — meals are simple and timed to set sessions. The Math also runs a goshala-side free-food service nearby. Pure-veg and strictly Jain; no charge. Cash for any seva donations.
signature_address: Shri Digambar Jain Mahasamsthan Math, near Vindhyagiri Hill, Shravanabelagola, Hassan District, Karnataka 573135

name: Sanmati Jain Marvadi Bhojanalaya
why_it_matters: A second Marwadi Jain bhojanalaya in Shravanabelagola town — a useful alternative to Suranga for pilgrims wanting strict Jain Marwadi food. Like the other bhojanalayas here it serves a traditional North Indian Jain thali; Shravanabelagola has very few non-Jain restaurant options, so these pilgrim kitchens are the core of the town's eating.
insider_tip: A backup to Suranga when it is full — both serve the same style of Marwadi Jain thali for pilgrims. Strictly Jain (no onion, no garlic, no root vegetables). Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Sanmati Jain Marvadi Bhojanalaya, Shravanabelagola, Hassan District, Karnataka 573135
